Symfony Polyfill / Php73
========================

This component provides functions added to PHP 7.3 core:

- [`array_key_first`](https://example.invalid/array_key_first)
- [`array_key_last`](https://example.invalid/array_key_last)
- [`hrtime`](https://example.invalid/function.hrtime)
- [`is_countable`](https://example.invalid/is_countable)
- [`JsonException`](https://example.invalid/JsonException)

More information can be found in the
[main Polyfill README](https://example.invalid/symfony/polyfill/blob/master/README.md).
